rootCause: The renderer passed Effect Duration runtime objects through the Lynx bridge while the connector protocol promised JSON-serializable DTOs.
Lynx structured cloning removed the Duration prototype identity. The main-owned Effect RPC client then rejected the cloned object with Expected Duration, got {.
Opening Providers mounted the health-check interval NumberField and triggered this invalid update, so General displayed settingsError after the route cycle and shifted its first section down by 58px.
fix: The shared connector protocol now schema-encodes ServerSettingsPatch before renderer-to-main transport and schema-decodes it before connector dispatch.
ServerConfig snapshots, pushed config events, and config-returning command results are schema-encoded before main-to-renderer transport and decoded before entering renderer product state.
Packaged Native and both Browser preview hosts now share the same JSON-safe transport contract instead of relying on Effect runtime objects surviving a bridge.
provenNativeDimensions: Dark and light exact-bundle runs visit all seven current Settings routes and complete two Providers-to-General reopen cycles.
Every reopened General panel starts at x=320, y=88, width=896 with no Expected Duration notice.
Both runs use the main connector transport, advance sequence, report zero renderer errors, return to chat, and dispose isolated state.
classification.evidenceBoundary: This evidence restores the already expected Native Settings interaction and runtime behavior. It does not change visual residuals, state weights, Browser evidence, material scores, or physical keyboard coverage.
